purpose: Destinations whose walked route lies clearly above the selected ERA5-Land model cell. Their pages carry a notice saying so. Display only: this list changes no score, gate, eligibility, ranking or approval flag. Whether such a destination may carry a recommendation at all is an open question for Sol (docs/next-expansion-batch.md).
inclusionRule: The median of the cited route elevations exceeds the published model elevation by more than goodMismatchMaxM in data-config/methodology/era5-land-representativeness-v1.json. Enforced by tests/route-above-model.test.ts. highestNearbyCellM is the highest ERA5-Land invariant-geopotential cell within 0.3 degrees (three cells) of the published cell, read from the cached orography; it must also stay below routeElevationM, so no nearby cell could be picked instead.

reviewedNotListed.tongariro: Tongariro Alpine Crossing runs 760 to 1,886 m (Ketetahi car park, Mangatepopo Hut 1,190 m, Red Crater 1,886 m); the 1,334 m cell sits inside that range.
reviewedNotListed.cradle-mountain: Dove Lake Circuit 938 to 989 m, with Marions Lookout 1,202 m; within 300 m of the 878 m cell.
reviewedNotListed.blue-ridge: No single route to cite; not reviewed.
